capabilities: embed a title in code blocks
show the code language name when no file name is given
configure handling of file names with half spaces
enable titles on published sites via publish.js and publish.css
extras: The author states they rarely use Obsidian anymore; maintenance is limited to security fixes, with no new features or non-security bug fixes planned. The plugin depends on Obsidian's internal DOM structure and may stop working. Docs cover Obsidian Publish support with downloadable publish.js and publish.css from the release page.
problem: Code blocks in Obsidian have no built-in way to display a title like the file name or language of the code they contain.
summary: Code-block enhancer that embeds a title, such as a file name or language name, above code blocks in notes.
